summary: Frontend-only validation completed for transitions, menu, typography, responsive behavior, chronicle regressions, product detail, and bag integration. Most functional flows pass, but page-swap timing under global wipe fails a critical requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Destination page state switches while wipe is in waiting state but panel is still off-screen (transform matrix(..., -800)); full viewport cover not active at content swap.
Menu logo bounding box overlaps nav bounding box across tested breakpoints (320/768/1024/1440/1920), violating non-overlap requirement.

integration_issues.issue: Observer-at-page-swap captured page change with wipeState=waiting and panel rect top=-viewportHeight, bottom=0 (not fully covered).

issues: Brand logo and navigation area overlap geometrically at tested breakpoints

action_items: Fix page wipe sequencing so app data-page/content swap cannot occur before panel fully covers viewport
Validate wipe state progression includes reliable covered point before swap and preserves ~520ms cover/reveal timing
Adjust menu brand/nav layout constraints to remove logo-nav overlap at all required breakpoints
critical_code_review_comments: PageWipe transition currently permits swap-time geometry where panel is off-screen during waiting; verify tween completion guarantees and swap gating by panel coverage, not only timeline callbacks.
MenuOverlay desktop/mobile sizing uses large absolute brand region and nav width cap; current constraints can intersect visually/geometrically at multiple widths.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: home background/color, hero asset (1600x900), typography assignment (Instrument Serif/Manrope), 6-card chronicle alignment, hover reveal, product modal fields, Add to Bag -> header count -> bag drawer, Escape close, same-page Chronicles menu behavior, contact close routes (home and chronicles), responsive overflow=0 across required breakpoints, no DOM cloning in chronicle loop. Re-test focus should be transition swap coverage and menu logo/nav overlap after fixes.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open home, install swap observer on [data-testid='objects-marketplace'] data-page mutation; on Home->Chronicles click, callback logs wipeState=waiting while panel transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,-800) with rect top=-800,bottom=0. This indicates swap happened when panel was not covering viewport. Likely mitigation: enforce content swap only after confirmed panel coverage bounds (rect fills viewport) and keep swap blocked if cover tween interrupted/aborted before reaching yPercent=0.
